candidates.name: Guard-pinned topological wall realization; energy through two scalar labels only
paper_items: M2-37 Prop wl:parameter-cost + target stair map P_0
supporting: M2-28 pre-stack contract, M2-29 routing, M2-30 period conservation, M2-24 walls
candidates.statement: Represent the approximant as P_0∘T∘h, where T (quantizer) collapses the target to a 2-complex with polar labels (t,s), and h is a homeomorphism built qualitatively so that sampled source walls (pulled-back level annuli/disks, routed with conserved parameter length) go to standard label walls. The derivative of P_0∘T∘h is controlled by the wall-parameter slope density G alone (no Dh). Realized labels are pinned to the carrier's labels because a misplaced layer would have to be joined to many nearby 'guards' (fibre paths of T h_g to boundary anchors) on every small sphere, forcing int G^p >= c a h^{2-p}, which contradicts capacities fixed before the guards when p>2.

candidates.name: Immersed cubical skeleton cutoff (universal-constant identity core with collapsible ball fibres)
candidates.statement: For h within cs of the identity on a band of the cube, a Whitney-layered 2-skeleton neighbourhood of the shell is immersed at common target scale s (|Di|~s/l). The lift H=i^{-1} h i satisfies |DH|<=A|Dh∘i|; per depth l the energy factor (l/s)^3 times overlap count (s/l)^2 sums geometrically, giving int_shell|DF|^p <= C_p int_band |Dh|^p with C_p universal. Uncontrolled hole fillings (Schoenflies) are collapsed to points, leaving countably many tame ball fibres that are opened later without energy estimates.
